notablePrerequisites: Horseshow Crab does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Horseshoe Crab's ability from Cryptolith Rites by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance's second ability triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Horseshoe Crab's own ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have infinite green mana, you may activate Leyline of Abundance's last ability any number of times.
